scope: Module-owned grouped Leptos notification inbox view with authoritative unread badge paging open authorization and bounded group actions

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

notifications_local_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the owner-local implementation ledger without replacing the large file wholesale

notifications_owner_docs_sync.follow_up: Safely revise the large owner README and live contract statements for the delivered native storefront UI

policy.bootstrap: Resource new_blocking loads exact unread count then the first bounded authorized group-summary page
policy.loading_boundary: SSR and client refreshes render an explicit skeleton while owner reads are pending
policy.empty_boundary: an authorized empty group page renders an explicit clear-inbox state
policy.error_boundary: bootstrap paging item open and group-action failures render sanitized transport messages without owner internals
policy.unread_boundary: the badge displays the exact owner unread count and is never derived from group pages
policy.summary_paging: group pages use owner cursors at 20 rows and append only returned unique group keys
policy.item_paging: one expanded group loads owner-authorized item pages at 20 rows and appends only returned unique notification IDs
policy.stale_response_boundary: group item requests carry a local request nonce so stale responses cannot overwrite a newer expansion
policy.open_boundary: browser navigation occurs only after fresh native open authorization returns an allowed internal route
policy.write_boundary: mark read mark unread and archive submit one owner page of at most 64 eligible rows with a fresh idempotency key
policy.refresh_boundary: successful writes invalidate expanded state and trigger authoritative unread and summary reload instead of optimistic count edits
policy.continuation_boundary: when a bounded group action reports has_more the UI asks the caller to repeat after refresh rather than starting an unbounded loop
policy.presentation_boundary: titles and bodies use bounded string template fields with semantic key fallbacks and render as text
policy.storage_boundary: paging state is in-memory only with no local storage or shadow inbox persistence
policy.badge_boundary: NotificationUnreadBadge is reusable but global application navigation composition is not delivered

not_delivered: global storefront navigation or header unread-badge slot
tenant-wide scheduled reconciliation and payload redaction
